ticket.title: Ticket OC-142: Monthly export for accounting
lines: Status is Done; the ticket was resolved in release 2.3.
Reporter is Hana, assignee is Minh, priority is Normal.
The estimate was three days and the work took four.
Acceptance criterion: the export downloads as a CSV file with one row per invoice.
Trang commented that she tested on staging with last month's data and all rows were present.
Minh commented that the column order matches the sample file from the client.

sections.heading: Japanese original (日本語原文)
lines: 目的：請求データをCSVファイルで出力する。
出力項目：請求番号、顧客名、金額、請求日。
出力ボタンは請求一覧画面に置く。

sections.heading: English translation
lines: Purpose: export invoice data as a CSV file.
Columns: invoice number, customer name, amount, invoice date.
The export button is on the invoice list screen.

meeting_notes.title: Meeting notes: design review and weekly syncs
lines: Attendees: Linh, Hana, Trang, and Tanaka-san on video.
The team showed the new invoice search screen; the client had no comments.
The next release date was confirmed as the 14th.
Tanaka-san asked for the test report to be shared after each release.
Action: Linh sends the updated schedule by Friday.
The weekly sync moves to Thursdays at 16:00.
